nodes.name: execution.rs
nodes.summary: Builds LLM prompts for project/agent/review sessions and orchestrates starting or launching work-item agent sessions, including worktree setup and agent-definition resolution.

nodes.name: build_project_prompt
nodes.summary: Builds the system/context prompt for a project-level agent session from frontmatter and body.

nodes.name: build_agent_prompt
nodes.summary: Builds the prompt used to launch a generic agent session.

nodes.name: build_review_prompt
nodes.summary: Builds the prompt used to launch a review session for a work item.

nodes.name: append_fix_feedback
nodes.summary: Appends prior review/fix feedback to a launch prompt.

nodes.name: parse_agent_defs_for_execution
nodes.summary: Parses agent definition files needed to resolve an execution context.

nodes.name: parse_agent_orgs_for_execution
nodes.summary: Parses agent organization files needed to resolve an execution context.

nodes.name: debug_parse_work_item_launch_sources
nodes.summary: Debug helper that parses and returns the raw sources used to launch a work item, for diagnostics.

nodes.name: load_agent_def
nodes.summary: Loads an agent definition by id from the workspace.

nodes.name: resolve_agent_def_id_from_assignee
nodes.summary: Resolves which agent definition id should handle a work item based on its assignee field.

nodes.name: resolve_launch_context
nodes.summary: Assembles the full launch context (config, agent def, account/model, worktree, linked repos) for starting a session.

nodes.name: append_workspace_section
nodes.summary: Appends workspace/linked-repo context to a launch prompt.

nodes.name: start_work_item
nodes.summary: Starts an agent session for a work item using its default launch reason.

nodes.name: start_work_item_with_reason
nodes.summary: Starts an agent session for a work item with an explicit lock reason, resolving context and building the prompt.

nodes.name: launch_phase_session
nodes.summary: Launches a review/fix/retry phase session for a work item, building the appropriate prompt.

nodes.name: PhaseLaunch
nodes.summary: Enum of work-item session phases that can be launched: Review, Fix, Retry.

nodes.name: helpers.rs
nodes.summary: Shared helper functions (string truncation, blocking task wrapper, slugification, ISO timestamps) plus the orchestrator config override data model used across project tooling.

nodes.name: truncate_preview
nodes.summary: Truncates a string to a max byte length for use in previews.

nodes.name: run_blocking
nodes.summary: Runs a blocking closure on a background thread pool and awaits its result.

nodes.name: resolve_slug
nodes.summary: Resolves a project/work-item slug from a raw input, disambiguating if needed.

nodes.name: slugify
nodes.summary: Converts a display name into a URL/filesystem-safe slug.

nodes.name: now_iso
nodes.summary: Returns the current time formatted as an ISO 8601 string.

nodes.name: OrchestratorConfigOverrides
nodes.summary: Overrides for orchestrator config: selected account/model, sub-agent ids, org id, agent definition id, worktree path, review config.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module that re-exports the project tool-infrastructure submodules (execution, helpers, projects, search, work_items).

nodes.name: projects.rs
nodes.summary: CRUD operations for project records (list, read, create, update, delete) backed by the workspace filesystem.

nodes.name: list_projects
nodes.summary: Lists all projects in the workspace.

nodes.name: read_project
nodes.summary: Reads a single project's data by slug.

nodes.name: create_project
nodes.summary: Creates a new project record with the given metadata.

nodes.name: update_project
nodes.summary: Updates an existing project's metadata fields.

nodes.name: delete_project
nodes.summary: Deletes a project by slug.

nodes.name: search.rs
nodes.summary: Implements full-text/keyword search across all workspaces for matching projects and work items.

nodes.name: find_across_workspaces
nodes.summary: Searches all known workspaces for projects/work items matching a query string.

nodes.name: work_items.rs
nodes.summary: CRUD operations for work item (task/ticket) records within a project, backed by the workspace filesystem.

nodes.name: list_work_items
nodes.summary: Lists all work items within a project.

nodes.name: read_work_item
nodes.summary: Reads a single work item's full data by project slug and short id.

nodes.name: create_work_item
nodes.summary: Creates a new work item with the given metadata, todos, and orchestrator overrides.

nodes.name: update_work_item
nodes.summary: Updates an existing work item's fields.

nodes.name: delete_work_item
nodes.summary: Deletes a work item by project slug and short id.

nodes.name: search.rs
nodes.summary: Formatted wrappers around code/file/glob/symbol search primitives (ripgrep-like) that assemble human-readable, truncated search results for agent tools.

nodes.name: code_search_formatted
nodes.summary: Runs a code content search and formats matches with context lines into readable output.

nodes.name: code_search_multi_formatted
nodes.summary: Runs a code content search across multiple paths and formats combined results.

nodes.name: read_file_lines_cached
nodes.summary: Reads and caches a file's lines for use in producing search context snippets.

nodes.name: parse_glob_extensions
nodes.summary: Parses a glob pattern into a set of file extensions to filter search results.

nodes.name: file_search_formatted
nodes.summary: Runs a filename search and formats matches into readable output.

nodes.name: file_search_multi_formatted
nodes.summary: Runs a filename search across multiple paths and formats combined results.

nodes.name: glob_search_formatted
nodes.summary: Runs a glob-pattern file search and formats matches into readable output.

nodes.name: glob_search_multi_formatted
nodes.summary: Runs a glob-pattern search across multiple paths and formats combined results.

nodes.name: symbol_search_formatted
nodes.summary: Runs a code symbol search and formats matches into readable output.

nodes.name: index_status_formatted
nodes.summary: Formats the current search index status for display.

nodes.name: truncate_output
nodes.summary: Truncates formatted search output to a maximum character length.

nodes.name: http_retry.rs
nodes.summary: HTTP request retry helper that honors Retry-After response headers when re-sending a failed request.

nodes.name: extract_retry_after_secs
nodes.summary: Parses the Retry-After header value from an HTTP response into a seconds delay.

nodes.name: send_with_retry
nodes.summary: Sends an HTTP request, retrying with backoff honoring Retry-After on failure.
